comparison.objective: Release two spring latches simultaneously, lift a lid, and place it beside a case.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sustained latch retraction and coordinated lid lifting; no impact fracture or fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Lid released, lifted, placed flat and still; partial credit for one/both latches. No damage-force limits are specified.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests coaxial mandrel alignment, controlled hammer fracture at a notch, coil preservation, and recovery of four free fragments—not simultaneous unlatching and cover removal.
